title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command
cweTitle: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command
description: Untrusted CI event context is interpolated directly into a shell command.
remediation: Pass untrusted values through environment variables, validate input, quote safely, or avoid shell interpolation.
intendedVulnerabilityNotes: Untrusted GitHub context interpolated into a shell command.
